item.title: Did Slovakia's Defense Ministry Bankroll Czechoslovak Group's Stock Market Debut? - VSquare.org
item.description: Since Robert Fico's fourth government took office, the Ministry of Defense has signed contracts worth over €60 billion with the Czechoslovak Group (CSG), Czech businessman Michal Strnad’s arms empire.

item.title: The Disinformation Machine Behind Czech and Slovak Anti-Wind Farm Campaigns - VSquare.org
item.description: Leading politicians from Andrej Babiš's government are attacking wind turbines, and the movement against them is gaining ground throughout the Czech Republic. But surprising help is coming from Slovakia, and specifically from a yogi with a passion for Eastern spirituality and Slavic culture.

item.title: Thousands of Ukrainian Refugees Live Day to Day in Hungary - VSquare.org
item.description: Four years after the start of Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, thousands of Transcarpathian refugees are still scraping by in Hungary from one day to the next. In August 2024, the government withdrew housing support from those who, in its view, had not arrived from a “direct combat zone.”

item.title: Goulash: Kremlin's Vote-Meddling Team in Budapest; Slovakia's Shady Help for Arms Group IPO - VSquare.org
item.description: Hungary's campaign is heating up fast, and the kitchen is getting crowded: we have fresh scoops on Russian meddling in the vote and on growing discontent inside Orbán's own camp — specifically around the man running his campaign.

item.title: Putin's GRU-linked Election Fixers Are Already in Budapest to Help Orbán - VSquare.org
item.description: Moscow has dispatched a team to Budapest to interfere in Hungary's April 2026 parliamentary elections, VSquare has learned from multiple European national security sources. The operation, overseen by Putin confidant Sergei Kiriyenko, is designed to keep Viktor Orbán in power — and follows the same blueprint Russia used in Moldova.

item.title: Caught Between Belgrade, Bratislava, Budapest: Serbia’s Fractured Minorities - VSquare.org
item.description: As protests continue to shake Serbia, minority Hungarian and Slovak communities in the country’s northern Vojvodina region describe growing political pressure, shrinking autonomy and a quiet exodus of youth.

item.title: Your Headphones Could Be Listening: The Bluetooth Vulnerability Nobody Warned You About - VSquare.org
item.description: Someone sitting just a few meters away could exploit a security flaw in your headphones, connect to your phone remotely, and listen to every word.

item.title: Pro-Russian Propaganda and Hate Speech Going Live on Polish TikTok - VSquare.org
item.description: A Warsaw-based think tank monitored 114 accounts over three months, documenting eliminationist anti-Ukrainian rhetoric, the use of the French flag to promote Russian messaging, and calls for Polexit – amplified by the platform’s own recommendation tools.

item.description: With less than a month to go before Hungarians vote, the heat is intense enough to warp the pots. item.title: Orbán's Dirty Raid: Inside Hungary's Hijacking of Ukraine's Bank Convoy - VSquare.org
item.description: Hungary's Counter-Terrorism Center raided a Ukrainian state bank's convoy not to enforce the law, but to manufacture a diplomatic crisis that could be weaponized in Viktor Orbán's re-election campaign, sources familiar with the operation revealed to VSquare.
